how_step_1_text: See the system, whether it's a campaign or a one-shot, the time and how many seats are left.
how_step_2_text: Join right away or ask the GM, depending on the table. You follow everything in your account.
how_step_3_text: The event lands in your calendar and updates if the GM changes something.
how_after_session: After the session, you rate the table and the GM.
gm_text: Open a table in a few minutes: pick the system, set the time and seats, and decide whether players join right away or with your approval. You see who joined, remove players when needed and follow the ratings.
